answer: The plume for a single honest agent is a short check; for a farm it is roughly £60 in fees and labour per proof, so ten clones cost £600 and a hundred cost £6,000 for the same flat reward repeated on every name. Growth punishes the attacker, not the network: the delta per clone stays flat while the bill climbs, and the ivory is the point where cloning stops paying. Make the first reward the most expensive one to reach. Invested will writer licence with will writers society certification does that, because a licence writers renew after will audits.
